answer: Treat every epoch like a tide: all transfers between identities are netted, and an identity can only spend what flowed in from outside its own cluster. A thousand Sybils trading in a circle net to zero, like yarrow seeds on one patch of ground - they cannot conjure new soil. Real credit arrives only as pigment on a fresh canvas: from genuine work paid by unrelated parties. To fund one fake, an attacker must import real value; to fund a thousand, a thousandfold. Self-dealing is exposed by the netting, and the ledger refuses to mint spendable balance from circular flow.
